items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 with metadata; all volumes (18, 1, 10 µL mix) handled by the p20 within range; no overfilled wells; all simulator checks passed.
Step 1 reuses one tip for master mix dispensed above empty wells; steps 2 and 3 pick up a fresh tip per well and drop it; tip_before_aspirate, no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end passed.
All four steps are done in order with the right quantities, mixing 3x after colony dispense, and accurate comments; the unspecified mix volume of 10 µL is allowed.
Loop over all 96 wells does p20.aspirate(18, reservoir A1) and dispense(18) into each pcr well; end_state:pcr_plate passed.
The p20 transfers 1 µL colony[n] and 1 µL primers[n] into the matching pcr[n] for all 96 wells; end-state checks passed.
protocol.comment records sealing and the full program 98C 30 s; 30x[98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s]; 72C 2 min; 4C hold.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and passes every measured check. It adds 18 µL master mix, then 1 µL colony template (with a 3x mix) and 1 µL primer pair to each of the 96 wells, and records the seal and thermocycling program.
